latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of rtx-local-ai — turn your gaming PC with an NVIDIA RTX GPU into a local AI server.

- Run large language models (LLMs) like Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, Phi, Mistral locally on RTX GPUs (4090, 4080, 4070, 3090, etc.)
- Supports single or multiple RTX PCs for AI workload sharing (fleet mode)
- Easy setup on Windows and Linux using Ollama Herd
- No cloud costs: your GPU is the server for inference, code generation, image generation, and embeddings
- Includes monitoring dashboard and CLI status tools
- Explicit user control for model download and deletion; no automatic downloads
